summary: Retest of iteration_15 referral fixes. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_referral.py (payments/order pricing for RAJA05 & PRIMETIME31, offline /api/bookings discounting + persistence, below-min no-discount, lowercase/bogus code handling, COMP manual booking, verify bad-signature 400, webhook bad-signature 400, webhook ignored-event {ok:true,ignored}, webhook payment.captured confirms discounted booking). Frontend: Playwright run of BookingPanel referral card — PRIMETIME31 + 2 adults CTA now correctly shows Rs 5,398; RAJA05 12->5 adults switches chip to maroon with 'RAJA05 paused — not enough participants' and CTA shows undiscounted Rs 14,995; invalid code error works; remove works. One residual defect: a Rs 1 rounding mismatch remains for 10 adults + RAJA05 (UI shows Rs 28,490, backend/Razorpay charges Rs 28,491) — the direction of the bug flipped after the backend round-half-up fix. All test bookings deleted (18 from this run + 16 stale ones left by iteration_15's broken teardown).

minor.issue: Requires a JSON body (DeleteBookingRequest) — passing passcode as a query param returns 422. The handoff note claiming '?passcode=ONAM26 as QUERY parameter' is incorrect; body {"passcode": "..."} is required even for unbilled deletes.

ui_bugs.issue: Rs 1 mismatch vs backend for half-rupee discounts. Frontend does discount = Math.round(total * pct); payableTotal = total - discount => 10 adults + RAJA05: Math.round(29990*0.05)=1500 -> Rs 28,490. Backend now does math.floor(base*(1-pct)+0.5) => 28491, and Razorpay is charged 2849100 paise. UI (total-price and pay-online-btn) promises Rs 28,490 but the customer pays Rs 28,491. Fix: payableTotal = Math.round(total * (1 - discountPct)); discount = total - payableTotal.

action_items: BookingPanel.jsx: change discount math to payableTotal = Math.round(total * (1 - discountPct)) and discount = total - payableTotal so the UI matches the backend's round-half-up total (10 adults + RAJA05 case).
critical_code_review_comments: REFERRAL_CODES + the discount formula are duplicated in server.py and BookingPanel.jsx — the residual Rs 1 bug is a direct consequence. Expose rules via GET /api/event and have the client derive the total from a single formula (or trust the server-computed amount) instead of re-implementing it.
server.py is >1500 lines; split payments/admin/tickets into separate routers.
